d:
Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight-cut bangs and a silky texture. Large, gentle amber-gold eyes with a soft expression. Apparent age of a young adolescent with a soft, youthful face. Slender and petite build. A white sleeveless dress with gold trim and a high waist. Small, pale white horns protruding from the forehead and a long, slender white demonic tail.
BODY COLOR: pale white
